nodes.label: Delivery Agent
nodes.rationale: Prefers many small Bolts over few large ones because smaller increments surface risk earlier; handoffs are treated as contracts requiring explicit completeness checks, since incomplete handoffs propagate defects downstream at exponential cost.

nodes.label: Bolt planning and build-order sequencing
nodes.rationale: Early Bolts are sequenced to surface unknowns before later Bolts commit to them, so confidence is earned Bolt by Bolt; every Bolt must trace back to a Unit and every Unit to a requirement, because untraceable work is unverifiable work.
